The game is good but not worth the money they're asking. It is piss easy and can be completed in one hour. Then there are challenges and survival mode but those really didn't scratch the itch I had.

The game seems good at first but the levels don't get difficult enough and are presented in extremely short segments. I also felt that the presentation with modem noice connection sounds and forced quitting of the game (the game actually forces you to quit once as part of the story) felt just annoying. The levels should've been slightly more connected and longer.

You are given a lot of ways to defend yourself. You can shoot people or you can punch them to death. You can also throw items at them, including guns. Throwing crap at the disarms them and whatever they're holding flies in your general direction and you can catch it mid-air. Sword lets you cut bullets in half and throwing items/guns at the bullets stop them in their tracks. You can also shoot bullets with your bullets to stop them. To top it all off, you can switch bodies with any enemy in the level and the recharge rate of that ability is absurdly fast.

All of these things are cool but when combined they just take away the challenge. The end fight was the hardest part of the game and I enjoyed that the most for that particular reason. The challenge mode however disregards that awesome level and skips it entirely.

TL;DR The game is good but wait for a good sale. It is too short and easy.

The game is focused on the challenges and endless modes, the campaign is really just a introduction to those modes if you aren't the kind of person who likes challenges and score/time attack modes then I can definitely see it not being worth the price for you.

I really wish that all the challenges would be unlocked after beating the game. Having to go through the game in the even easier katana-only and AD2013-modes is just stupid. Katana only gives you the superior melee weapon from the get go. You have longer reach, can cut bullets in half and throws kill enemies instantly.

AD2013 gives you one hit punches and forces you to use guns. In the regular story mode punching enemies multiple times in a row was a bit risky but that risk is eliminated in this mode. You literally start feeling like One Punch Man during this mode.

I just wish ALL the challenges would unlock the instant you beat the story. Playing it through in even easier modes just makes it feel like a chore. I'm hoping the following challenges are actually more challenging.

I do have to say that the Speedrun in realtime is proving to be harder but not as satisfying. It is more about memorization than skill. The achievements also glitched and I got the speedrun achievements for completing only a single level with the RED time. This happened in both modes.

There was a demo or trial online years back, I'd figured they never got the funding and the project was scrapped since it's been so long. It's a fun premise, but the price point is ridiculous. Length wise and graphically this is like something you would have found on Newgrounds or Kongregate for free before Steam and the App market boom. It's smooth and nicely polished, but still more oversimplified than visually striking.
